claims.text: Total net revenue for COMPANY_05 increased by 2.75% from $177,556 million in 2024 to $182,447 million in 2025.

Net interest income increased by 3.09% from $92,583 million in 2024 to $95,443 million in 2025, driven by higher Markets net interest income, higher revolving balances in PRODUCT_26, higher wholesale deposit balances, and the impact of investment securities activity, partially offset by deposit margin compression and the impact of lower rates.

Noninterest revenue increased by 2.39% from $84,973 million in 2024 to $87,004 million in 2025, despite a decrease in other income due to the absence of a $7.9 billion net gain related to ENTITY_04 shares recorded in 2024.

initial_report.rationale: COMPANY_05 shows modest revenue growth, with both net interest income and noninterest revenue contributing to the increase.
